newsitem.title: CHINA: China August CPI 8.1 pct yr/yr - State Statistics.
newsitem.headline: China August CPI 8.1 pct yr/yr - State Statistics.

text.p: China's consumer price inflation rose 8.1 percent in August compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said in a report issued by the Xinhua news agency on Tuesday.
That compared with consumer price inflation of 8.3 percent for July, official figures showed.
The State Statistical Bureau said consumer price inflation was up by 1.5 percent compared with the July rate of increase but gave no details.
China has already reported retail price inflation of 5.8 percent for August, up by 1.3 percent compared with the July rate of increase.

The bureau attributed the first upturn in the inflation rate since February to rising vegetable and meat prices as well as the impact of floods that swamped large swathes of central and southern China in June and July.
Retail sales volume rose 16.7 percent, or 10.3 percent in real terms, over the same month last year, to 191.6 billion yuan in August, the bureau said.
